honesty_preamble: This audit does NOT claim 99% of all VOC content on the internet. It targets 99% of the defined open machine-readable breath-VOC compound universe (EPA VOLATILOME / HBDB backbone). HBDB live HTML, restricted SQL, Owlstone gated Atlas, and exhaustive PDF scraping remain out of scope.

universe.definition: Open, machine-readable human exhaled-breath VOC resources that can be fetched over allowlisted HTTPS APIs/files without executing untrusted code, accepting restrictive licenses, or bypassing Cloudflare/paywalls.

in_scope.title: EPA CompTox VOLATILOME breath chemical list

out_of_scope_blocked.title: HBDB website (hbdb.cmdm.tw)
out_of_scope_blocked.reason: Cloudflare-blocked; HTML scrape refused by secure_fetch policy

out_of_scope_blocked.title: Breath Biopsy VOC Atlas (Owlstone)
out_of_scope_blocked.reason: Gated commercial partnership access (Gates/FDA), not open bulk API

out_of_scope_blocked.title: Exhaustive full-text scrape of all breath-VOC papers
out_of_scope_blocked.reason: Paywalls, ToS, and non-machine-readable PDFs; we use DOI metadata + curated panels instead

ninety_nine_percent_target.note: 99% refers to the open machine-readable compound universe (VOLATILOME), not 99% of all online VOC content ever published.

gaps.detail: HBDB claims ~1140 compounds / 2766 refs; live DB blocked — using VOLATILOME 777 as open substitute
Breath Biopsy VOC Atlas is gated; not bulk-downloadable
Mechanistic predictor still uses 50 VOCs; extended catalog is inventory/coverage, not full retrain
Europe PMC harvest is metadata-only; no automated full-text VOC table extraction yet
